label: arginine arylamidase activity
definition: A phenotype in which a microorganism exhibits arginine arylamidase/arginyl aminopeptidase activity, releasing N-terminal arginine or lysine residues from peptides or hydrolyzing arginine and lysine arylamides.
observations: Follow-up from the physiology diagnostic-enzyme gap sweep; absent from METPO and TraitMech after an arginine arylamidase duplicate review covering ignored and hidden files.
related_synonyms: L-arginine arylamidase|aminopeptidase B|arginine aminopeptidase|arginyl aminopeptidase|L-arginine aminopeptidase
